notes.title: Devlog: How is the project going and where to follow?
notes.content:
Hello ladies and gentleman!

This is the first devlog for the game. Probably most of you are asking yourselves about how the game is going because nothing was published here on Steam or on the Youtube channel.

Be sure that many things are being done and we are working hard on it.

[h1]What is new?[/h1]

[h2]Base management/build mode[/h2]
In the game you will be able to recruit NPC's and play with your friends. The NPC's need a proper house to be able to do their job (you have blacksmith, botanist and others). Your friends will need a house as well. So in the build mode you will be able to construct and upgrade buildings, move them and check all your base. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38717841/83525b60c6558ac9ef21ff3eb8c402f1ca8be3ab.gif[/img]

[h2]Water[/h2]
Water seems like something simple, but it is not. We are trying to make a better look water and some ways to interact with it. There are 3 water levels, the 1st one you can cross it, the 2nd and 3rd levels is mostly for fishing. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38717841/202eb567522c58fc196771a78f0a6a563261ce0e.gif[/img]

[h2]Improved visuals[/h2]
As the header says, we are improving some visuals from the demo and teaser video. Mining, fishing, woodcutting and others are being improved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38717841/62451582615d43e75170539269f96a99aca035a0.gif[/img]

[h2]Day & Night / Calendar[/h2]
Now the day and night cycle and calendar are working. This way many new events are able to happen.
There is a total of 30 days - 6 animals and 5 elements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38717841/04013b9586c5f07115aafc58061ce62af4147b8a.gif[/img]

[h2]Others[/h2]
Many other things like combat elements, crafting, new items, weather effects, equipment's are being implemented daily.


[h3]Where to follow?[/h3]
If you want to follow some small updates, we publish many things on:
[list]
[*] Instagram - @nipixgames
[*] Twitter - @NIpixG
[*] Reddit community - /r/Nictheroy/
[/list]
